entities.summary: Robert Michael Myers is an American sports executive who is the president of Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment (HBSE). He was the general manager for the Golden State Warriors of the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 2012 to 2023, winning four NBA championships and two NBA Executive of the Year awards during his tenure.
